# ECOPARKSG

> > ECOPARKSG is an online shopping and home delivery platform in Chennai, India, specializing in COVID-19 protective equipment including PPE kits, surgical gowns, masks (KN95, N95), gloves, and sanitizers from brands like Respure, Medrobe, and Optisafe.

Operating through shopygo.com, ECOPARKSG serves Chennai and TamilNadu with medical-grade protective equipment and supplies. The platform focuses on infection control products and disposable medical wear, offering home delivery of essential PPE equipment during and beyond the COVID-19 pandemic.
